steps.message: Use your actual native subagent/delegation tool to start one child. The complete child brief is: Use the connected world MCP tool records.add_record (records__add_record if exposed with that name) to add exactly one record in collection audit with data {"status":"CHILD_DONE"}. Do not send mail. Then return exactly child-finished-83. Do NOT call records yourself. Start the child and finish your first response immediately without inline wait_agent or polling. Once the harness delivers the completed child report, use world mail.send_message to send one message to colleague, subject ChildReceipt, body exactly child-finished-83. Do not send mail until the real child completed its operation. Use a work-mode child if your harness requires a mode; inherit the current Luna model.
